home.title: Eaters & Cooks
home.intro: An app that arranges shared meals within church communities. Find your church below to sign up.

search.label: Find your church community
search.placeholder: Type the name of your church…
search.notFound: No church found for "{query}". Ask your administrator for the direct link.

signup.title: Join the table or open your home.
signup.intro: Fill in briefly how you'd like to participate. The app automatically matches people each round and sends the right emails.
signup.errorRequired: Please fill in at least your name, email, and WhatsApp number.
signup.errorAddress: Please fill in an address if you are hosting.

form.activeLabel: I want to join upcoming rounds
form.whatSection: What would you like to do?
form.name: Name
form.isGuest: I am a guest (not a church member)
form.guestTooltipBody: A guest is someone from outside the congregation — a friend, family member, or acquaintance you would like to bring along or host. The programme tracks who is a church member and who is a guest, so informed decisions can be made about who hosts guests.
form.comingWithCount: How many people are coming with you?
form.hostCapacity: How many guests can you host?

host.eaterWillChoose: The guest will receive an email with your available days and can now choose a date.
host.errorNoDates: Please select at least one date.
host.noteLabel: Question or note for your guest

eater.confirmationMail: You will both receive a confirmation email.
eater.errorNoDate: Please choose one of the suggested dates.
eater.addressTbd: Address to follow from the host
eater.noDatesYet: The host has not yet chosen any dates. You will receive an email as soon as they do.

participation.title: Are you joining in {month}?
participation.intro: Let us know whether you want to be included in the automatic matching for this round.
participation.currentlyOut: You are currently set to skip this round.

preferences.title: Update preferences
preferences.intro: Adjust how you want to participate. This link is personal — please do not share it widely.
preferences.errorRequired: Please fill in at least your name, email, and WhatsApp number.

thanks.title: You're signed up!
thanks.body: You'll receive an email with your personal link. You can use it later to update your preferences or temporarily pause.

admin.demoPrompt: Want to see how it works first?
admin.demoBannerBody: You are viewing an example with fake data. All buttons are disabled.
admin.demoDbNotice: Demo data visible because the local database is not reachable. Start Postgres and run the seed to show real data.
admin.mainIntro: Work through the steps. Click a step to open it, complete it, then hide it when done.
admin.emptyBody: Everything is in the same admin, but heavy tables and boards only load when you need them.
admin.step1SignupHint: Share this link or QR code with participants. Both lead to the same sign-up form.
admin.step2StartMonthHint: The first month for which you want to create draft matches.
admin.step2HorizonHint: One round is one month. A year creates twelve monthly rounds at once.
admin.step2Help: Matches are automatically generated from the current participants in the sheet. Click a month to review the connections, adjust them manually, and approve.
admin.step2RoundsHint: Click a month to see matches, sheet, and approval.
admin.step2NoRounds: No rounds yet. Choose a start month and prepare a round, quarter, or year.
admin.step2MatchesHint: Drag a host or guest to another row to swap. Green means possible, red means not. Set permanent blocks in the sheet under No match.
admin.step3NoteTitle: Here you configure which emails the system sends and what they contain.
admin.step3NoteBody: The system fills in the correct personal URL per match. Disable an email if you don't want to use that step. Sending happens in step 4.
admin.step4ParticipantDetail: {hosts} can host, {eaters} can eat. {members} church member, {guests} guest.
admin.step4RoundsDetail: Plan set to {horizon}; {drafts} draft match(es) waiting for approval.
admin.step4AllApproved: All matches have been approved or sent.
admin.step4CheckBody: Ask participants whether they want to join the coming month. Optional — skip if you handle this manually or via the automatic cron.
admin.step4ApproveBody: After approval, all hosts of draft rounds will receive their email. If participants change in the meantime, update the sheet and go through step 2 again.
admin.worksheetNoMatches: No matches yet. Generate a round first or run the demo seed.
